## Half Giant, Half Fish-Man

A Wotan has a giant's body and a fish-man's breath. Elbaph claims them, Fishman Island claims them, and the sea doesn't care either way.

Be of the Wotan race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Wotan race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

## The Biggest Fish in the Sea

Finish both books and reach 45,000 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Giant Warrior Pirates](r_wotan.md#q-1cb9db0058af8049), [Knight of the Sea](r_wotan.md#q-61306e8c449a837f)

- Reach 45,000 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +100,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your race)
